svg.title: SIES undergraduate record
svg.desc: SIES undergraduate record. Historical definition. School cohorts with valid ID; SIES enrollment in the 2 years after expected school completion, not first entry. Rates (%). Nominal uncertainty interval: 97.5 %. SIES record in 2 years after expected school completion: −2.3 pp; ESTIMABLE_DESCRIPTIVE. Linkage bound uninformative
